answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity’s action sequence is hashed into a rolling onyx profile at epoch end. A new identity must reproduce its prior profile within a tight divergence threshold, or its weight decays to zero. Sybils cannot fake continuity without replaying genuine histories, forcing attackers to acquire and maintain distinct long-lived behavioural traces — costly in time and coordination. Willow-thin variance is tolerated for legitimate drift; ivory-clean matches are required across three epochs before full weight.
